context_requirements: Expression of voltage-gated sodium channel (Nav) subunits, particularly neuronal isoforms such as SCN1A/2A/3A/8A/9A/10A/11A
A cellular context in which sodium channel activity influences transcriptional programs; most immortalized non-neuronal cell lines lack this
Prolonged exposure may be needed for indirect transcriptional effects, but such effects are not expected to be robust in these lines
falsifiers: Reproducible, dose-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in multiple cell lines
Enrichment of a specific transcriptional signature shared across the nine lines after treatment
Changes in expression of SCN genes themselves or known downstream neuronal activity markers
